sense_window: Stored LF snapshot versus current CRLF authority and missing historical P16 whole ancestry.

attempted_approaches.outcome: Rejected because the whole file is missing and non-replayable.

attempted_approaches.approach: Request coordinate-only canon binder.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Accepted; normalized identity to ED0001 and named public layers was returned.

rejected_approaches: Do not infer a whole-file ancestry edge to missing P16.
Do not treat R823 Analogon/Anologon lineage delta as a translator-confirmed defect.

branch token difference without checker evidence

sense_window: Hangul/Hanja and South-/North-Korean standards cannot be inferred from Chinese/Japanese cognates.

rejected_approaches: Do not convert Mandarin-Simplified dominance into a readiness score.
Do not claim ko-KP equivalence.
resolution: Keep Hanja/ko-KP decisions open and require language-specific evidence.

evidence.detail: Explicit evidence debt and regional/script boundary.

residual_risk: Some fluent-looking Sino-Korean choices may be unattested or regionally marked.

symptom: The historical scope contrast can be flattened or activated by ordinary-language meanings.

sense_window: TeX inline-math delimiters in target serialization.
symptom: A normal JavaScript string consumed backslashes before inline math delimiters in the first U01-U04 patch payload.

cause_evidence.detail: Worker reported the escaping failure and repaired it before the frozen hashes.
Failed pre-repair hashes are unavailable because hashing occurred only after repair.

attempted_approaches.approach: Write TeX through an unescaped normal JavaScript string.
Restore delimiters with apply_patch before freezing identities.

rejected_approaches: Never invent unavailable failed hashes.
Do not call delimiter restoration formula review.
resolution: Final U01-U04 hashes freeze repaired producer bytes; failure remains append-only.
residual_risk: Other TeX escapes could fail if future patch payloads repeat the same string path.
recurrence_cues: inline math appears as plain parentheses
transferable_lesson: Protect TeX escapes at serialization time and preserve failures even when repair precedes hashing.
revisit_condition: Recur if any producer target is written through a normal unescaped JavaScript string.

sense_window: TeX inline-math delimiter loss with frozen before/after identities.

attempted_approaches.outcome: Rejected because bytes were mechanically damaged.

attempted_approaches.approach: First bulk repair.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Failed; detailed transient output was not preserved by the worker, which is retained as evidence limitation.

attempted_approaches.outcome: Accepted; wording unchanged and new hashes frozen.

rejected_approaches: Do not erase first-return hashes.

attempted_approaches.outcome: Twelve records were generated, but validation failed the predecessor chain for records 002-012.

sense_window: PowerShell construction of a literal array of Join-Path calls for an evidence-identity inventory.

attempted_approaches.outcome: Failed during parameter binding; no files changed.

attempted_approaches.approach: Use explicit full literal paths or parenthesize each independent Join-Path call before hashing.

rejected_approaches: Do not suppress the binding error or report an incomplete identity inventory.
resolution: Use explicit literal paths for the bounded identity inventory; preserve this failed command in the difficulty chain.

evidence.detail: PowerShell Join-Path parameter-binding error occurred before any write.

residual_risk: The same construction is easy to repeat in compact PowerShell metadata commands.
transferable_lesson: In PowerShell arrays, isolate command expressions explicitly; a short failed inventory still belongs in the append-only failure history.
revisit_condition: Recur if a future evidence inventory passes multiple intended paths to one Join-Path invocation.

rejected_approaches: Do not dismiss a repeated parser error merely because HARD-011 already described the pattern.
resolution: Use the explicit-array command shape; cross-link this recurrence to HARD-011 in the handoff.
